paragraphs.text: DeepSeek Harness plugin: a model-facing `chrome` tool that drives the installed Google Chrome over C
DP — screenshots returned as images, DOM/text/eval, console & network diagnostics, real input events
. Runs in the Host, so no per-call approval and no bash sandbox limits.
# chrome-browser

A DeepSeek Harness plugin that gives the model a
`chrome` tool: it drives the **Google Chrome instal

led on the machine** over the Chrome DevTools
Protocol, so front-end work can navigate, screenshot,
inspect, and interact with real rendered pages.
The tool runs inside the Harness Host process, which has two consequences worth knowing:

- **No per-call approval.** A `chrome` call is an ordinary tool call; it never asks for shell or
san

dbox permission.
- **It is not affected by the shell sandbox.** On Linux, Chrome cannot start under

a Landlock-confined
shell (it aborts with `chrome_crashpad_handler: --database is required`), so a p

lain
`google-chrome --headless …` bash command fails on a hardened Host. The Host process is not con

fined,
and the plugin runs there.
Works on Linux, macOS, and Windows: the browser is located per platform, the sandbox flag follows th

e
platform, and Windows process-tree teardown uses `taskkill`.

Screenshots are returned as real images in the tool result (when the model route accepts image
input

) **and** written to a file, so the model sees the rendered UI while a human can open the exact
PNG

ritten to a file, so the model sees the rendered UI while a human can open the exact
PNG afterwards.
A real render, captured by the tool itself — astro.build at 1280×800:
## Tool reference

One tool, `chrome`, with an `action` parameter. Page ids (`p1`, `p2`, …) come from `open`; every
lat
er action takes an optional `page` and otherwise uses the most recent one.
| Action | Key parameters | Result |
| `open` | `url`, `width`, `height`, `deviceScaleFactor`, `mobile` | Starts Chrome if needed, opens

a page. |
| `goto` | `url`, `page` | Navigates an open page and waits for load. |
| `screenshot` | `
path`, `fullPage`, `selector`, `width`, `height`, `scale` | PNG image + saved path; viewport by defa

ult. |
| `viewport` | `width`, `height`, `deviceScaleFactor`, `mobile` | Resizes the emulated viewpo

rt (responsive checks). |
| `dom` | `selector`, `maxChars` | `outerHTML` of the document or of one e

lement. |
| `text` | `selector`, `maxChars` | `innerText` of the body or of one element. |
| `eval`

| `expression`, `maxChars` | Evaluates JavaScript in the page, returns the JSON value. |
| `click` |

`selector` or `x`/`y`, `button`, `clickCount` | Real mouse events at the element centre. |
| `type`
| `selector`, `text`, `clear`, `submit`, `delayMs` | Focuses, clears, inserts real input events. |
| `press` | `key` | `Enter`, `Tab`, `Escape`, arrows, `Home`, `End`, `PageUp`, `PageDown`, `Backspac

e`, `Delete`, `Space`. |
| `wait_for` | `selector` or `text`, `timeoutMs` | Polls until the selector

matches or the text appears. |
| `console` | `clear`, `limit` | Collected `console.*` calls, uncaug

ht exceptions, browser log entries. |
| `network` | `clear`, `limit` | Failed requests and HTTP 4xx/

5xx responses seen while attached. |
| `pdf` | `path` | Prints the page to a PDF file. |
| `tabs` |

– | Lists open pages. |
| `close` | `page` | Closes one page. |
| `stop` | – | Terminates Chrome and
removes its temporary profile. |
## Requirements
- Google Chrome or Chromium (any recent version; developed against Chrome 155), on Linux, macOS, or

Windows. Chromium-based Microsoft Edge is accepted as a last resort on Windows.
- Node.js 22+ (uses

the global `WebSocket`).
- No npm dependencies: the plugin imports only its sibling module and Node.

js built-ins.
- For CJK pages install a CJK font (`apt-get install fonts-noto-cjk` on Debian/Ubuntu,

or the Noto CJK
fonts on Windows/macOS); without one, screenshots render those glyphs as empty boxe

r the Noto CJK
fonts on Windows/macOS); without one, screenshots render those glyphs as empty boxes.
## Install into a Harness profile
The Host imports plugins only from its own module roots (the profile and the dsh installation), so t

he
bundle must be installed as a **real copy inside the profile**, not as a link to a checkout:
[代码示例省略，未执行]

Then install that tarball through the Harness plugin manager (`plugin_manager`, `action:
install_bun

dle`, `target` = absolute tarball path). The Host reports `restart-required` when it
replaces an alr

eady installed package; restart `dsh web` to load the new module generation. A
version bump changes
the dependency spec, which is what makes an update detectable.
## Configuration
The bundle patch sets these; `apply` merges them over its own defaults and validates them.
| Key | Default | Meaning |

| `chromePath` | `''` (auto-detect) | Browser executable. |
| `headless` | `true` | Run without a wi

ndow. |
| `noSandbox` | `true` on POSIX, `false` on Windows | Pass `--no-sandbox`; required when the

Host runs as root, unnecessary on Windows. |
| `userDataDir` | `''` (fresh temp dir per start) | Ch

rome profile directory; set it to a plain ASCII path if the system temp path upsets Chrome. |
| `def

aultWidth` / `defaultHeight` | `1280` / `900` | Default viewport. |
| `maxOutputChars` | `100000` |

Default cap for `dom`/`text`/`eval` output. |
| `navigationTimeoutMs` | `30000` | Navigation and `wa

it_for` budget. |
| `artifactDir` | `''` (system temp) | Where screenshots and PDFs go when no `path

t. |
| `artifactDir` | `''` (system temp) | Where screenshots and PDFs go when no `path` is given. |
